description.value: Painstaking contingency plans and a reliable backup power source allow your exocortex to continue processing data and follow your programming even when you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Unconscious] or dying. When you have 0 Hit Points or are otherwise unable to act, you can take 3 actions per round on your turn, but all of these actions must involve your exocortex. You can't use any actions with the manipulate or move trait. For example, you could still Command your drone, fire your turret, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Detonate Mine], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Reposition Exocortex], but you can't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Deploy Mine], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Modify], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Synchronized Step].
